items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Wins FDA Review For BOTOX Cosmetic In Jawline Treatment Push
items.summary: Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, reported that the FDA has accepted for review a supplemental Biologics License Application for BOTOX Cosmetic to treat masseter muscle prominence. If cleared, BOTOX Cosmetic would be the first neurotoxin approved in the U.S. for this condition, supported by positive Phase 3 trial data.
